evidence_basis: Reread for membrane-property questions with the full Methods (solutions, junction potential, cell selection, access resistance, definitions of Rin, tau, sag, rebound), Table 1, Results 2.1 and 2.6, Discussion, the reference list entry for the cited ZD7288 neocortical study, and the supplementary docx (text). Images viewed: Fig 6 (panels A-C) and Supplementary Fig S4 and S2. Figs 1-5 and Supp S1 and S3 images were not viewed; they bear on bursting and synaptic currents, not on the membrane numbers used. Coverage for figures is declared captions_only because not every figure was viewed; the depth is partial for that reason.
